import subprocess, pathlib, os, resource, time
root=pathlib.Path('/work/tmp/probes');root.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
def run(name, source, args, files=None, timeout=3):
 d=root/name;d.mkdir(exist_ok=True);(d/'justfile').write_text(source)
 for path,content in (files or {}).items():(d/path).write_text(content)
 def limits():resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CORE,(0,0))
 try:
  t=time.monotonic();p=subprocess.run(['/target/debug/just',*args],cwd=d,stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.PIPE,text=True,timeout=timeout,preexec_fn=limits)
  print(name,'code',p.returncode,'time',round(time.monotonic()-t,3),'stdout',repr(p.stdout),'stderr',repr(p.stderr[:1800]))
 except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:print(name,'TIMEOUT',timeout)
 return d
run('private_mod','[private]\nmod secrets\n\npublic:\n',['--fmt'],{'secrets.just':'hidden:\n'})
